title: Why Data Centers Are Turning to Metal AM for Thermal Management
summary: Nikon SLM Solutions' blog retells the Danish Technological Institute and Heatflow passive two-phase evaporator, printed in one aluminium piece on an SLM280, which it says reached 600 W in tests against a 400 W target. It argues metal powder-bed printing suits joint-free evaporators with built-in wicks. Figures are company-reported.
manufacturing: Single-piece aluminium L-PBF on an SLM280.

title: 2026 F1 Cooling: Why Bigger Radiators Are Needed
summary: An explainer says the 2026 MGU-K rises from 120 kW to 350 kW and, at 95% efficiency, sheds about 17 kW of heat, while 20% more heat needs roughly 20% more radiator core area. It says the energy store and power electronics run dielectric cooling loops at about 50 °C. No data or named sources.
thermal: 2026 F1 power-unit heat loads and radiator sizing.

title: Test Programme Fully Validates Precooler at Hypersonic Heat Conditions
summary: Reaction Engines tested its UK-built precooler in Colorado at Mach 5 airflow conditions, quenching air above 1,000 °C in under 1/20th of a second, after an earlier 420 °C (Mach 3.3) test. The programme was backed by DARPA, the UK Space Agency and ESA, with BAE Systems as investor.
manufacturing: Built at Reaction Engines' UK headquarters; hot-flow tested.

title: Liebherr-Aerospace delivers 100,000th heat exchanger
summary: Liebherr-Aerospace Toulouse delivered its 100,000th heat exchanger in April 2023, up from 37 in 2002, and now makes nearly 12,000 a year for aircraft air-conditioning systems, with repair and re-coring centres in the US, Singapore and China.
manufacturing: In-house production and re-coring; no process detail.

title: Cooling solution reduces thermal constraints, weight and size of commercial plane components
summary: NLR's TOPMOST project (H2020, 2017-2019, €712k) built two pumped two-phase cooling demonstrators for aircraft power electronics, with most parts 3D-printed in aluminium. The system weighed 2.5 kg, was 42% smaller than required, removed 2,400 W (twice the requirement) and kept hot spots within 2 °C, and passed vibration and salt-spray tests.
thermal: Pumped two-phase loop for power electronics.
manufacturing: Mostly printed aluminium parts; vibration and salt-spray tested.

title: Kelvion K°Bond Is The Cutting-Edge Heat Exchange Solution
summary: Kelvion's K°Bond diffusion-bonded heat exchanger is claimed to be up to six times smaller than shell-and-tube units and rated to 1,000 bar and -200 °C to 600 °C, with hydrogen and supercritical CO2 named among its uses. Etched stainless plates are diffusion-bonded into a solid core. All figures are company claims.

title: Advancing diffusion bonded compact heat exchangers for high temperature applications
summary: A short INL-led article on improving diffusion bonding for compact heat exchangers in advanced nuclear reactors, from a DOE NEUP integrated research project. No data on the page.

title: Development and Characterization of Additively Manufactured Metallic Porous Structures for Transpiration Cooling Applications
summary: DLR made porous structures from the superalloy VDM780 by laser powder bed fusion, setting porosity through process parameters, and measured through-flow pressure loss and how evenly coolant flowed out. The abstract gives no figures.
manufacturing: L-PBF porous superalloy, porosity set by parameters; flow tests.

title: Research Progress on Transpiration Cooling Porous Materials and Their Thermal Protection Performance
summary: A Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen) review of porous materials for transpiration cooling of hypersonic vehicles, covering materials, preparation routes and how pore structure affects protection.

title: Shell-Side Flow Field in a Doughnut and Disk Baffle Shell Tube Heat Exchanger
publisher: ASME Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer
summary: University of Oxford measured the shell-side flow field of a doughnut-and-disk baffle shell-and-tube heat exchanger, a layout used for oil coolers with a better heat-transfer-to-pressure-drop ratio than segmental baffles.

title: Flow and heat transfer characteristics of microchannel air-oil heat exchangers for aero-engine cooled cooling air system
publisher: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part G Journal of Aerospace Engineering
summary: Shenyang Aerospace University simulated microchannel air-oil heat exchangers for cooled cooling air in aero-engines and found airfoil-shaped pin fins gave more heat transfer for less pressure loss than other pin shapes.

title: Influence of the Surface Roughness on the IWP-Type TPMS Heat Exchangers
summary: Dalian University of Technology and the Beijing Institute of Power Machinery studied how surface roughness changes the performance of IWP-type TPMS heat exchangers. No abstract was available.
